source.additional_artifact_provenance: Existing research downloads and uploaded technical handoff bundles associated with the research work; original filenames and bytes retained.
source.outline_download_note: Download suffixes are retained, not promoted to formal protocol version numbers. The file with suffix (10) contains the later source-recount and setup claims.

publication.warning: The original working archive states that some motivating names or rules originated in private discussions and that it was not cleared for public release. Recovery and user-directed publication do not certify its provenance, licenses, scientific claims, or reviewer blinding.
publication.reviewer_blinding_note: This is an author-side historical recovery branch containing proposals, prior review records, and development outputs. Do not direct an unexposed reviewer to browse it before their independent worksheet is locked.

v1_slot_definition.lexical_rule: Lowercased ASCII declaration-name tokens split on non-[a-z0-9]; descending set Jaccard, then ascending pair hash.
v1_slot_definition.lineage_rule: At least one identical directly referenced pinned source/relation ID supported by trustworthy extraction; ascending pair hash.
v1_slot_definition.metric_id_literal: json.dumps(["metric-v1", project_relative_yaml_path, yaml_list_location, declaration_name], ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":"))
v1_slot_definition.project_key: lowercase GitHub owner/repo plus @ plus the recorded 40-character pinned commit
v1_slot_definition.pair_id_order: metric IDs sorted by their UTF-8 bytes into id_low, id_high
v1_slot_definition.hash_input_literal: json.dumps(["pair-v1", project_key, id_low, id_high], ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":"))
v1_slot_definition.hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes; pair-v1 is the domain separator and deterministic seed, with no additional seed
v1_slot_definition.duplicate_and_failure_rule: Retain source-qualified numeric declarations, duplicate-name cases, and extraction failures in the complete within-project unordered pair frame.
v1_slot_definition.empty_slot_rule: Pick the next unused pair in each scheduled stratum; an empty or untrustworthy stratum leaves an empty slot without refill.
v1_slot_definition.primary_draw_gate: Full source-qualified ID/pair frame frozen, two reviewers plus a distinct adjudicator committed to the recorded budget, and identical prediction-free packets and a one-request-per-pair table frozen before predictions or reviewer value runs.

frozen_decision_rules.version_boundary: The original conditional explanation rule, compiled review-priority rule, and later narrow aggregate-mask rule are distinct development versions. The compiled review priorities abstain from semantic decisions; the later narrow rule is a Jaffle development demonstration, not evidence of portable held-out superiority.

baseline_comparators.note: Original code and report bytes are retained. A recovered report is not a newly executed method run.

later_independent_twenty_declaration_sou.note: The later independent YAML recount with exact names, verified source spans and source hashes has not been recovered as its own original dated inventory. The earlier broad-frame audit and compiler-visible/source-screen lists are not substitutes. No historical inventory was reconstructed or fabricated.

later_coordinator_setup_records.note: The latest outline describes later setup checks, but the corresponding original dated records and checked CSV snapshot have not been recovered from these bundles.

integrity.common_credential_pattern_scan: No matches for GitHub tokens, private keys, AWS access keys, OpenAI keys, or explicit bearer/token/basic authorization headers in the original pilot and six additional research ZIPs.
integrity.verification_limits: No held-out values or pair methods were run. Checks requiring SQLGlot, PyYAML or DuckDB were not run because those dependencies are not installed in the verification runtime. The obsolete default Python 3.7 runtime is insufficient for some recovered syntax.
